author: PictureFrames
body:
Well, it's by popular demand. 

I'm sure most of you have been wondering what's been going on in the world of Administration, as it's appeared to be fairly quiet. However.. A lot of planning has gone on. Because of the great ideas you guys have been suggesting, we narrowed it down. Tel and I will be hosting an Official Avicus UHC.

Details will be announced in a seperate post consisting of when, where, and how it's going to work. I hope to see you all there!

Regards, -Jake
